Earth Live · code and shaders: MIT license, © 2026 Elfonie.
The images and star data below keep the terms of their sources. They were resized, converted, compressed and in part combined. This app is free; it is not endorsed by NASA, ESA, GEBCO, the IHO or the IOC.

Earth
Blue Marble: Next Generation with Topography and Bathymetry (2004), Reto Stöckli, NASA Earth Observatory / NASA Goddard Space Flight Center.
science.nasa.gov

City lights
Night Lights 2012 map, NASA Earth Observatory image by Robert Simmon, using Suomi NPP VIIRS data provided courtesy of Chris Elvidge (NOAA National Geophysical Data Center).

Relief and ocean mask
Derived from an image by Jesse Allen, NASA\'s Earth Observatory, using data from the General Bathymetric Chart of the Oceans (GEBCO), The GEBCO_08 Grid, www.gebco.net, British Oceanographic Data Centre. Not for navigation.

Moon
NASA\'s Scientific Visualization Studio, CGI Moon Kit (SVS 4720), based on LRO LROC WAC data, NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University.
svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720

Milky Way
NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio, Deep Star Maps 2020 (SVS 4851). Gaia DR2: ESA/Gaia/DPAC; Hipparcos and Tycho-2 (ESA).
svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4851

Clouds
Solar System Scope textures, based on NASA data, license CC BY 4.0.
solarsystemscope.com/textures

Stars
AT-HYG database by David Nash (astronexus), license CC BY-SA 4.0; based on The Hipparcos and Tycho Catalogues (ESA SP-1200), data from the European Space Agency (ESA) mission Gaia (Gaia DPAC), the Yale Bright Star Catalog (Hoffleit 1991) and the Gliese-Jahreiss catalog (1991). Changes: filtered to about 870,000 stars, positions computed for 2026, colours derived from the catalog colour index, packed into a binary table. codeberg.org/astronexus/athyg

Methods
Atmospheric scattering after Bruneton and Neyret (2008) and Hillaire (2020); Sun and Moon positions after Jean Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms.

Use
Gaia data are published by ESA under CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO and the GEBCO_08 data have non-commercial terms of their own, so this app is free, without ads, prices or donation links. No warranty.
